text: 商务部公告，自2026年8月14日起，对原产于印度的进口单模光纤继续征收反倾销税，实施期限为5年。此举是基于对原产于印度的进口单模光纤倾销可能性及对中国产业损害可能性的调查结果。
text_en: The Ministry of Commerce announced that starting August 14, 2026, anti-dumping duties on imported single-mode optical fiber originating in India will continue to be levied for five years. This action is based on the results of an investigation into the likelihood of dumping of single-mode optical fiber originating in India and the likelihood of injury to China's domestic industry.
